hypothesis: The best menu configuration is already combining the strongest discovered ingredients, so a plain menu-axis swap is unlikely to beat 0.6040 by much. The next focused improvement is custom Path B ensembling of two complementary rankers that are both already validated individually: (A) the current best FM recipe with BPR + recency Bayesian prior + mean-pooled positive history + aux tasks + lower_lr_longer, and (B) the DIN-style DeepFM recipe that underperformed alone but likely captures higher-order candidate-history matching missed by FM. Their errors should be only partially correlated: FM+prior is strong on memorization/popularity and coarse interactions, while DIN attention is targeted at user-specific relevance among a user’s impressed items. Because metrics are within-user ranking, blending scores after per-user z-normalization can preserve each model’s useful ordering signal without needing test labels. We choose the blend weight by validation primary only, then score test blindly. This is a narrow, evidence-based additive change on top of node 10 rather than a new direction.
